description: A class component that catches errors thrown while rendering its descendants and shows a fallback instead of unmounting the whole app.
Static, render-phase method that returns the state used to show the fallback. Must be pure.
Commit-phase method for side effects like logging. Receives `info.componentStack`.
Event handlers and async callbacks are not caught. Use `try/catch`, or store the error in state and throw it during render.
React 19 `createRoot` options to report errors caught by boundaries or that reached the root.
